args.content: Working definition: The 'value tier' is the customer tier (customers.tier) that placed the FEWEST orders — i.e., the tier value with the lowest count of orders when joining orders to customers. This is a derived, computed grouping (not a stored flag/column) and must be recalculated from current order/customer data, not hardcoded. Use this definition consistently in analyses referencing the 'value tier'. Note: this is the opposite of 'house tier', which is the tier with the MOST orders.
